note: Kentucky State Parks campground near Jamestown, on a wooded ridge between Pumpkin Creek and Lake Cumberland, set back from the water. The full-hookup sites sit together on the first spur past registration. --Claude
summary: Kept. 87 sites but only 11 take RVs (full hookup, 15/30A, back-in, 30-40 ft); 76 tent-only. $35 Sun-Thu / $40 Fri-Sat / $45 holiday; bathhouses, laundry, two dumps. year_round (manual) confirmed by parks.ky.gov and RA. Not waterfront confirmed. PIN MOVE ~440 m to the full-hookup spur. Website fix; policy copies cleared.
flags: SEASON (manual, not written): year_round true CONFIRMED. parks.ky.gov 'The campground is open year-round', RA 'Open year round', and site 112 is bookable on Dec 2026 and Jan 2027 dates. CONFLICT in wording only: the stored season note 'Water is not guaranteed in freezing weather; call the park.' is softer than parks.ky.gov's 'water facilities operate seasonally and are closed during the winter months'. The old note gave 'water off Nov 1-Mar 15'; I found no dated source for those exact dates. The reviewer may want to change the manual season note to say the water facilities close in winter.
SITES: count 87 confirmed, but only 11 sites are RV sites; the other 76 are 'Tent Only'. max_rig_ft 40 (110; the others are 30-35) and pull_through false added.
HOOKUPS: electric 30 added ('15 & 30'). Water and sewer confirmed (full-hookup sites).
FEES: 35/40 -> 35/45 (holiday $45). Policy copies (reservation_fee 6, extra_person) cleared to the state:KY row.
FACILITIES: showers, flush toilets and laundry (RA amenity) added; dump confirmed (two stations).
WATERFRONT: not waterfront confirmed. The full-hookup spur at ~36.9195,-85.0460 is on a wooded ridge ~430 m from the nearest lake arm, and RA says 'Near Water - no' on every site.

PIN MOVE (>250 m): stored 36.9222,-85.0423 is on the main park road ~440 m NE of the campground. Target 36.9196,-85.0458 (the full-hookup spur just SW of the registration building at ~36.9198,-85.0452).
